description: The canonical Renovate configuration of every farcloser repository, as a shared preset: each repository's renovate.json extends it by reference, pinned to the repository's own limen version, so a fix here reaches every repository at its next limen bump instead of waiting for a file nobody re-seeds. Reasoning: limen's book, mandatory files (CI workflows).
extends: config:recommended, plus aqua's preset, which detects owner/repo@ver and go-module packages in aqua.yaml, updates the standard-registry ref, and bumps aqua_version in CI too.
minimumReleaseAge: supply-chain cooldown before proposing a bump; doubles as protection against a release tag whose assets are not uploaded yet.

packageRules, own releases: the cooldown guards against third parties (a tag whose assets are still uploading, a release pulled the next day). A release cut by one of our organizations carries no risk we do not already own, and its assets are published by the release workflow within minutes — so farcloser, forkcloser and mycophonic packages, in aqua's owner/repo form and Go's github.com/owner/repo form alike, are proposed as soon as they exist. A repository that wants the cooldown back on one of them adds a later packageRule in its own renovate.json; rules merge in order and the last match wins.

vulnerabilityAlerts: fix PRs from GitHub's Dependabot alerts (the baseline keeps the alerts on for exactly this; Dependabot's own update PRs are off, Renovate is the one bot). Stated explicitly because enabled: true here is what reaches // indirect Go modules, which the gomod manager skips by default. Fix PRs skip the cooldown and take the lowest fixed version, both Renovate defaults for this object.
postUpdateOptions gomodTidy: a Go module bump rewrites go.mod; without tidy, go.sum keeps the old module's lines and `just do lint go mod` (go mod tidy, diffed) fails every gomod PR.

customManagers: the go_install tools pinned as github.com/<owner>/<repo>[/<pkg>]@vX.Y.Z in aqua.yaml (local registry). aqua's generic manager cannot read a dotted owner, and its _go/ hook needs the two-line version: form that `aqua update` refuses to bump, so these one-line pins get their own manager on the go datasource (module tags, /vN aware, a package path below the module root resolves to the module's tags). Only plain vX.Y.Z: a pseudo-version has nothing to order against and is left alone.

packageRules, content-pinned files: the checksum-update workflow, the setup-aqua action and everything under .limen/ are limen's byte for byte; a bump Renovate makes inside one is drift the next `limen check` rejects. Their pins move in limen's own repository, the one place Renovate keeps touching them, and reach every other repository through a limen release.
packageRules, Go-source analyzers: go.mod tool directives (deadcode, govulncheck, go-licenses), which Go lists as // indirect and the gomod manager would skip; re-enabled exactly.

packageRules, go toolchain: golangci-lint embeds Go's type checker, so a golang/go bump can only land with (or after) a golangci release built with that Go; one grouped PR keeps the two in lockstep and the lint recipe's toolchain check names the fix when they still disagree.

packageRules, lychee: releases are tagged lychee-vX.Y.Z next to lychee-lib-vX.Y.Z and nightly; regex versioning that carries the prefix parses the pin and the candidates alike and excludes the others by construction.
commitBody: `just do lint commits` enforces DCO on every PR range, bot commits included.
